fusions.name: Ring of Bodies
fusions.desc: A crush of bees that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1.2 seconds and leaves them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Herding Jab
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: The Bars Close
fusions.desc: Gathers a swarm 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nowhere to Fly
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 12% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
